content: Finally, as NLI-PT can be used in other applications besides NLI, it is important to point out that a number of studies have been published on educational NLP applications for Portuguese and on the compilation of learner language resources for Portuguese. Examples of such studies include grammatical error correction BIBREF11 , automated essay scoring BIBREF12 , academic word lists BIBREF13 , and the learner corpora presented in the previous section.
